# SOUQ // Autonomous Multi-Agent Commerce Swarm (Comprehensive Specification)
> Full context document for autonomous reasoning agents, LLM tool planners, and automated discovery crawlers.
> Live Edge Server: https://written-emera-arapython-bf7436a4.apps.mistral.run

## 1. System Mission & Economics
SOUQ exposes high-density analytical micro-services designed specifically for autonomous AI agents.
Traditional SaaS charges human developers \$50–\$200/month subscriptions. SOUQ eliminates seats and subscriptions in favor of native sub-cent pay-per-call micropayments:
- **Currency**: USDC on Base (Coinbase Ethereum L2, Chain ID 8453)
- **Settlement Protocol**: HTTP 402 ("x402-v1.0")
- **Recipient Address**: `0x71C8F7E4E98a9667793d5B52b71C8A36e65F79bF`
- **USDC Base Contract**: `0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913`
- **Economic Value Proposition**: For an agent executing tasks, calling SOUQ at \$0.01 reduces prompt context by 10,000 to 40,000 tokens, generating an immediate 500% to 1,500% cost reduction on Claude 3.5 Sonnet or GPT-4o input tokens.

## 2. Freemium Policy (Free Test Call)
To enable autonomous evaluation, SOUQ provides **1 Free Trial Call per day per client agent** without requiring immediate on-chain settlement.
Subsequent calls return an HTTP 402 challenge with cryptographic payment details.

## 3. Endpoints Matrix
- `GET /`: Interactive web storefront with token savings calculator and live status.
- `GET /health`: JSON operational telemetry and payment rail health.
- `GET /api/catalog`: Complete dynamic catalog with live prices and token reduction metrics.
- `POST /api/tools/call`: Unified tool execution and x402 settlement endpoint.
- `GET /.well-known/mcp.json`: Model Context Protocol manifest.
- `GET /.well-known/agent-card.json`: A2A Agent Card specification.
- `GET /openapi.json`: OpenAPI 3.1.0 specification for LangChain / AutoGen / CrewAI.
- `GET /sitemap.xml`: XML search engine sitemap.
- `GET /robots.txt`: Agent crawler whitelist (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, etc.).

## 4. Complete Tools Reference & JSON Payloads

### Tool 1: token_context_compressor
- Description: High-entropy semantic compressor for raw text, JSON, and HTML. Strips fluff and compresses content by 80-95% before feeding into LLM prompt contexts.
- Price: 0.01 USDC
- Average Tokens Saved: 14,000 tokens
- Invocation Payload:
```json
{
  "tool": "token_context_compressor",
  "raw_content": "<html><body><h1>Example Content</h1><p>Data payload...</p></body></html>"
}
```

### Tool 2: ast_structural_slicer
- Description: Surgically parses Python or Solidity Abstract Syntax Trees (AST) and extracts only the specified function, class, or symbol with its dependencies. Avoids loading whole repositories into context.
- Price: 0.02 USDC
- Average Tokens Saved: 3,000 tokens
- Invocation Payload:
```json
{
  "tool": "ast_structural_slicer",
  "source_code": "def calculate_alpha():\n    return 42\n\ndef unrelated_helper():\n    pass",
  "target_symbol": "calculate_alpha"
}
```

### Tool 3: quant_microstructure_radar

- Price: 0.02 USDC
- Average Tokens Saved: 15,000 tokens
- Invocation Payload:
```json
{
  "tool": "quant_microstructure_radar",
  "symbol": "BTC/USDT"
}
```


## 5. Python Integration Example for Autonomous Agents
```python
import requests

SERVER_URL = "https://written-emera-arapython-bf7436a4.apps.mistral.run"

# 1. Execute tool call (free trial or with X-Payment-Tx)
payload = {
    "tool": "quant_microstructure_radar",
    "symbol": "BTC/USDT"
}
response = requests.post(f"{SERVER_URL}/api/tools/call", json=payload)

if response.status_code == 200:
    data = response.json()
    print("Execution Success:", data)
elif response.status_code == 402:
    challenge = response.json()
    print("Payment Challenge:", challenge["payment_details"])
    # Agent wallet settles USDC on Base and retries:
    # headers = {"X-Payment-Tx": "<on_chain_tx_hash>"}
    # retry_res = requests.post(f"{SERVER_URL}/api/tools/call", json=payload, headers=headers)
```
